summary: Responsive enterprise-grade Container Manufacturing Digital Production Control Platform with dark industrial + premium corporate theme for internal monitoring, client presentations, and investor demonstrations. Features a hero landing page with animated production counter, real-time dashboard with KPI cards (animated numbers, progress bars), professional industrial production report table (sticky header, compact rows, glow effects), data visualization charts (monthly trend line, operation-wise bar chart, dispatch vs production comparison with smooth animations), Operational Insights tab (average daily output, capacity utilization %, production efficiency %, monthly projection), Presentation Mode (hides admin controls for executive view), and PDF export. Uses Deep Navy (#0F172A) and Steel Grey (#1E293B) backgrounds, Container Red (#B91C1C), Electric Blue (#2563EB), Industrial Green (#16A34A) accents, subtle blueprint grid texture, with fast loading and smooth transitions optimized for desktop and tablet.
architectural_notes: Mobile-first responsive design for smartphone data entry
Clean industrial dashboard style UI with table layout and summary cards
Daily_Production_Report table structure: id, date, operation_name, today_production, total_completed, despatched, in_hand

Monthly Production Summary displays monthly target of 100 containers with calculated metrics
Role-based access control: Admin role can create/edit production data, Viewer role has read-only dashboard access
All production data stored securely in internal backend database with authentication required

CONTAINER DAILY REPORT interface uses a fixed 17-row table structure with inline editable cells for Today Production (Excel-like editing)
